# lodash.isequal v4.5.0

The [Lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.isEqual` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.isequal
```

In Node.js:
```js
var isEqual = require('lodash.isequal');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#isEqual) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.5.0-npm-packages/lodash.isequal) for more details.
